candidates.change_summary: Replace the return of the stored owner with msg.sender so owner() returns the caller instead of the actual owner.
Replace the return of the stored owner with the zero address so owner() always returns address(0).
Delete the zero-address check so ownership can be transferred to address(0), changing the resulting owner value.
Transfer ownership to address(0) instead of newOwner, so owner() becomes the zero address regardless of the argument.
Invert the ownership check so that any caller other than the owner can call transferOwnership, allowing non-owners to change the owner.
Delete the `_;` statement from the onlyOwner modifier so guarded functions never execute, leaving the owner unchanged after a transferOwnership call.
Make paused() always return true instead of the stored _paused flag.
Make paused() always return false instead of the stored _paused flag.
Invert the returned flag so paused() returns !_paused.
